concerns.text: The plan cites the MS‑COCO 2017 parquet dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/ChristophSchuhmann/MS_COCO_2017_URL_TEXT/resolve/main/mscoco.parquet) as the sole data source, but this dataset provides only caption text (and possibly image metadata) without the actual image pixel data required for activation‑variance measurement and FID/CLIP evaluation. Since the research requires both captions *and* the corresponding images, the cited dataset is inappropriate for the intended experiments.
